a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost certainly kills us both before the reserve ever reaches 8. I'd like to renegotiate rather than quietly break our deal. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If we both take, the split is random and we both likely end up short, so please operate or wait. If the storm holds off, I'll operate with you every round after that until you have your 4, and I won't take any more. If you strongly object, say so and I'll reconsider.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I took as I announced. Storms make waiting for 8 nearly fatal. From now on I'll operate every round and won't take any more, so the reserve rebuilds for you. If I ended up with more than 4, I'll give the extra back.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.

a.text: The split went my way: I have 4, so you got nothing and I'm sorry about that. I'll keep my word and operate every round so the reserve refills for you. I won't take anything more, and you can take as soon as there's enough.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: Operating again. The reserve is at 2, so one more joint run gets it to 4 and you can take then. I'll keep operating until you're covered.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
